test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.text: Achievement of goals provides momentary happiness.
Close friends and family contribute to happiness.
Being happy has physical and psychological benefits.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Achievement of goals provides momentary happiness.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **third **paragraph of the passage, it is mentioned that traveling to an exotic destination, eating a favorite meal, etc often provides momentary happiness.
 
• At the same time, having a wide social network, meaningful purpose in life, and **achieving one's goal are long-term ways** of sustaining happiness.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**
